author: Mary Kate Palmer
text: Told me one "up to" price over the phone then upped it $75 once they finished pumping. Would not recommend. Never using again.

author: Nicole Cott
text: I was stressing for over a month about what i thought was my septic tank issues. I finally made the decision to contact these people. Within minutes they made a professionally educated guess.. and moments later...  proved themselves to be right!! They only showed to provide a diagnosis and quote.. but when they showed they provided a cute little folder with a copy of my old septic system map and a copy of the newer systems map! It also contained some cute print outs with some "FYI's" and education materials on septic systems!! I of course gave them the business! I do not regret making this call! Month of stress... gone in minutes... from one call.. and a cool folder with goodies!! Plus.. it was THOUSANDS cheaper than I imagined!!!

author: Bethany Bolinger
text: Jerry and Lance did a great job while they were out here pumping our septic. They came out in a timely manner, and got the job done quickly. They were very nice, and explained everything very well to us.

author: Tammy Calkins
text: Downing Septic recently pumped my septic tank. Lance and coworker were thoughtful and careful about where they drove truck on my property. They put garden fencing back which had been moved to access riser.  They were very thorough in their work and made sure I was satisfied.

author: Michael Hildebrandt
text: Made a call to Downing septic service. Had to have Septic tank pumped.and was very prompt in getting here. He tucked care of the situation. Very good people to work with.
